title: Not sure if this is mall world but here's my experience
content: I don't go to the mall often, haven't in years. But I've had regular ( but no often) dreams of a mall. Sometimes the layout is diffrent Alot of times it's this crazy like 10 or more story building with a crazy escalator. Last time I was there there was an abandoned video game store, think game stop, except they had old ps2 and gamecube games and stuff. In that one I tried to nick all the games I had growing up from there stock. There was no one around. That's the reoccurring theme when I have these store dreams. I'm always trying to get video games and video game consoles, and it's always old ones. One time I was on the floor of a mall and there was like some weird like, idk secret passage or something. Always very strange when I end up in the malls Any theories as to what's going on here ? I'm particularly interested to hear more paranormal/spiritual explanations of this seeming archetype in the human imagination
